fusions.name: Branching Gore
fusions.desc: Gores the target for 12 damage and leaves it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on the target spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Sidelong Sweep
fusions.desc: Sweeps side to side, dealing 4 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles. It then branches to 2 more enemies within 3 tiles, each hit dealing 60% of the original damage.

fusions.name: Hold the Pass
fusions.desc: For 8 seconds, 50% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it, leaving them [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Parted Thrust
fusions.desc: Each time you strike with your weapon, a second thrust finds the nearest other enemy within 4 tiles and deals 5 damage. Once every 5 seconds. You have 5% more dodge chance.
